# Charting the Course for the Next Generation of Mariners


Nov 5, 2026


Share


The maritime professionals of tomorrow are getting a high-tech addition to the classroom.


Carnival Corporation recently supported the installation of OneOcean Passage Manager at the National Maritime College of Ireland (NMCI), one of Europe’s leading maritime training institutions. The voyage planning and navigation software complements NMCI’s simulator facilities, giving cadets and students experience with technology used across the maritime industry.


The effort marks the start of a collaboration with NMCI and OneOcean focused on sharing industry knowledge and helping prepare future maritime professionals for careers at sea.
